RCSP-172.feature: Stock Count – Add Item searchable type-ahead
RCSP-172.description: Verify Add Item searchable type-ahead across Daily Shift Count, Weekly Count, and Monthly Count.

prerequisites: Store hierarchy and inventory items are configured

inactiveItem.note: Update to a real inactive item/PLU in QA when available

testCases.testName: Verify navigate to Daily/Weekly/Monthly Count and open Add Item popup
testCases.description: Navigate to all Stock Count pages, create counts, and open Add Item popup.
testCases.preCondition: Valid QA access, admin credentials, store hierarchy and inventory configured.

testCases.testName: Verify type-ahead returns matches for partial item name across count types
testCases.description: Partial name search (e.g. egg) returns matching active items on all count pages.

testCases.testName: Verify type-ahead returns matches for PLU search across count types
testCases.description: PLU search returns matching items with name/PLU/UOM on all count pages.

testCases.testName: Verify inactive items are excluded from type-ahead results
testCases.description: Inactive inventory items must not appear in Add Item search results.

testData.note: Set inactiveSearchTerm to a known inactive item/PLU in QA to fully assert exclusion.

testCases.testName: Verify item name, PLU, and UOM auto-populate after selection
testCases.description: Selecting an item auto-populates name, PLU, and UOM on all count pages.

testCases.testName: Verify UOM remains read-only after item selection
testCases.description: UOM cannot be manually edited after selecting an item.

testCases.testName: Verify no matches for invalid item search text
testCases.description: Invalid search shows no matching inventory items without crashing.

testCases.testName: Verify special character handling in item search
testCases.description: Special characters do not crash the app or return unrelated items.

testCases.testName: Verify leading/trailing spaces are trimmed in item search
testCases.description: Search with padded spaces still returns relevant matches.
Uppercase and lowercase searches return the same matching items.
